scope: Independent read-only review of generated-projection replacement and its two fixed output callers. No corpus build, removal or projection installation was performed by this reviewer.
findings: Both callers use fixed additive structured-units/structured-context roots; source and historical release roots are not passed.
Mode, output/root type, path traversal and symlink checks precede writes; unknown or changed surplus files reject without overwriting the declaration.
A retired file must appear in the prior declaration and match both exact byte length and SHA-256. It is rehashed immediately before removal.
Read-only check mode never retires files. Prior declarations are replaced last, and publication remains a separate verified release.
Six existing controls cover exact retirement, unknown/changed surplus, check-only behaviour, directory symlink and context-root escape. Source producer identities include the new helper.
limitations: This helper is not a transactional filesystem commit. A write failure or concurrent mutation may leave an incomplete generated checkout, requiring check/rebuild before publication. It never claims such a checkout is deployable.
Review covers local fixed-root callers, not permission to use this utility on arbitrary directories.
